title: Savings Club Vaccine Discount Rate Card for Immunization Services
content:
# Savings Club Vaccine Discount — Rate Card for Immunization Services Cash Doses

**Rate.** On the charge for a cash-paid dose of Kestrel Pharmacy's Immunization Services, the Savings Club discount is:

| Patient's savings programme on record | Savings Club discount |
|---|---|
| The active savings programme's vaccine discount percent is above zero, **and** a membership fee was charged in the last 12 calendar months | That programme's vaccine discount percent |
| The active savings programme's vaccine discount percent is above zero, **and** no membership fee was charged in the last 12 calendar months | **5 percent** |
| Any other case | Nothing (zero percent) |

## Where the records are read

The rate rests on the patient's enrollments under **Savings & Copay Assistance Programs**:

- **The active savings programme** is the patient's programme enrollment in active status; its **vaccine discount percent** is the percent off a vaccine's cash price that the programme itself carries.
- **A membership fee charged** is a membership fee charge entry in that programme activity.
- **In the last 12 calendar months** means dated fewer than 12 whole calendar months before today. A whole calendar month has passed once the same day of the month is reached again.

## Both sides of the thresholds

- A programme whose vaccine discount percent is zero, or no active programme at all, gives no Savings Club discount, whatever fees are on record.
- A membership fee charged 11 whole months and some days before today lies inside the 12 calendar months; a fee charged exactly 12 whole calendar months before today, or earlier, lies outside them.
- With a discount percent above zero, the presence of a fee in the window selects the programme's own percent; its absence selects 5 percent.

## Examples (hypothetical inputs)

The programme percents below are hypothetical and are not the rate of any named programme.

1. Active programme carrying a hypothetical vaccine discount of 12 percent; a membership fee charged 3 months ago. Savings Club discount: **12 percent**.
2. The same programme; the only membership fee was charged 14 months ago. Savings Club discount: **5 percent**.
3. Active programme whose vaccine discount percent is zero; a fee charged last month. Savings Club discount: **nothing**.
4. No active programme. Savings Club discount: **nothing**.
